# Matt Pocock

Matt Pocock writes AI Hero, a site on AI coding workflows, and is the author of the [[The Home Repo Pattern (article)]].

## Background

Publishes a dictionary of AI coding terms (skill, `AGENTS.md`, session, grilling, progressive disclosure, sandbox, software factory) and a public skills repo, `mattpocock/skills`, which the article cites as an example of shared skills.

## Key ideas

- The [[Home Repo]]: one repo for skills, `AGENTS.md` and shared docs, pointing at your other repos.
- [[Grilling]]: have the agent interview you in rounds, with a recommended answer for each question.
- [[Progressive Disclosure]] for keeping pointer lists small as repo counts grow.
- Deliberately small, composable skills and an openly anti-framework stance: he thinks BDD, "Spec It" (as transcribed) and Superpowers take away your control. His skills put the effort up front (`grill-me`, a shared glossary, ADRs, specs and tickets). See [[Skill Pack]].
